hook.name: DegenV3Hook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for DEGEN token launches on Robinhood chain that applies a time-decaying swap fee (up to 79% in the first 30 seconds post-launch, settling to a permanent 1%), split among an operating treasury, a DEGEN buyback vault, and a per-pool creator beneficiary. Fees are accumulated as ERC-6909 claims and can be flushed permissionlessly.
